title: Crystal Ball of Chaos
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on an ornate metallic stand, filled with vibrant, branching lightning-like energy in neon pink, purple, yellow, blue, and fiery orange. A woman's hand with long bright pink nails reaches from the right to touch the sphere, while colorful smoke swirls in the dark background.
